_about: EQUIPKEEP v1 (EquipKeep.cs): nothing is ever deleted by equipping. enabled false or no file = old behaviour. keepDisplaced: any item that leaves a slot of the player (replaced by a new weapon, the off-hand shield taken off by a two-hander, take off) is put in the carried list (loot_save owned) if it was not there, one [Equip] log line each. alwaysOwned: gear.json item ids that are always carried (joan_sword = the starting sword).
